verdict.rationale: Browserbase is an API-key-driven platform, so a documented per-key rate limit is a fair question. The evidence pack contains no documented requests-per-second or requests-per-minute limit, and no throttling behavior. The claim of 'thousands of concurrent browser sessions' is about concurrency scale, not a documented API rate limit, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I know the documented rate limit (requests per second or minute) enforced on my API key before throttling kicks in
